fields.name: login
fields.comment: Stored lowercase; 1–32 chars: a-z, 0-9, underscore, dot, hyphen.

tables.name: user_email
tables.comment: Only confirmed email addresses; one per account and one account per normalized email.

tables.name: email_verification_request
tables.comment: One pending email per account. Requests for the same email by different accounts are allowed.

tables.name: email_outbox
tables.comment: Physical table mail.email_outbox. Mail-owned durable SMTP queue; token payload is AES-GCM encrypted.
